# GENERATED FILE - do not edit. Regenerate with tools/gen_runtime.py
# Temporary probes preserve skill totals; the selected point is transferred as one pair.
# Positive effective skills avoid masked floor changes. No assumed native skill ceiling.

sxad_probe_diplomacy_effect = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = sxad_can_diplomacy value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = {
            diplomacy > 0
            scope:sxad_donor = { diplomacy > 0 }
        }
        scope:sxad_donor = {
            save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = sxad_donor_before_diplomacy value = diplomacy }
            add_diplomacy_skill = -1
            if = {
                limit = { trigger_if = { limit = { exists = scope:sxad_donor_before_diplomacy } diplomacy < scope:sxad_donor_before_diplomacy }
trigger_else = { always = no } }
                add_diplomacy_skill = 1
                scope:sxad_receiver = {
                    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = sxad_receiver_before_diplomacy value = diplomacy }
                    add_diplomacy_skill = 1
                    if = {
                        limit = { trigger_if = { limit = { exists = scope:sxad_receiver_before_diplomacy } diplomacy > scope:sxad_receiver_before_diplomacy }
trigger_else = { always = no } }
                        add_diplomacy_skill = -1
                        save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = sxad_can_diplomacy value = 1 }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
